Incident_Response_Playbook.Step_1: Identify the compromised IAM User AccessKeyId from the principalId field.
Incident_Response_Playbook.Step_2: Programmatically disable the active Access Key using AWS CLI or Wiz Console.
Incident_Response_Playbook.Step_3: Audit the cloud trail history for the preceding 2 hours to trace any secondary backdoors created.
